source_findings: Current atomic cohort batch acceptance now verifies exact barrier PID/snapshot binding, read-only S1 fd proof, writer-free proof, exact replay idempotence, and current nodes-table existence/health/capability before batch admission.

The atomic cohort path still identifies result authority by logical source_node_id plus current nodes-table state; it does not bind the exact monotonic membership admission/rejoin revision implemented separately by trigger2_node_membership_admission_acceptance_v1.py.

The executable-transition authority-mask line separately established that deterministic admission/lease/runtime IDs belong outside the learned cognitive target and should be attached by deterministic wrapping rather than predicted by the model.

new_gap.counterexample: A process can produce a packet while logical node x01 is on membership admission A. If x01 is later re-registered/rejoined with the same capability and healthy state under successor admission B, a batch path that checks only node_id+healthy+capability cannot distinguish the old process/result authority from the new incarnation.
new_gap.effect: Logical node continuity can be confused with process/membership continuity even though packet integrity, PID binding and current nodes-table health all pass.

fusion_decision.principle: Do not force the model/process-produced NODE_RESULT cognitive body to self-mint membership authority. Preserve the raw result packet as immutable cognition/evidence, then let deterministic runtime wrap that exact packet digest with controller-owned source membership and process-instance authority evidence.
why: It closes stale-rejoin/source-authentication ambiguity without teaching the model to generate authority IDs.
It preserves the raw child packet digest used by physical barrier/process proof instead of rewriting the packet after collection.
It composes naturally with atomic cohort IDs: cohort membership can be derived from exact authority-envelope digests, each of which references one immutable raw packet digest.
It matches the current Trigger-2 authority-mask direction: learned cognitive body inside, deterministic authority envelope outside.

spawn_and_barrier_binding: Before child launch, deterministic controller resolves the active node admission identity for each logical node and records it in a launch descriptor not generated by the model.
Parent launches the child and records parent-observed process identity; child self-reported PID must match parent observation.
Child emits the immutable raw NODE_RESULT cognitive packet and barrier witness as today; no membership authority field needs to be predicted by the child/model.
After collection, deterministic controller creates the authority envelope binding launch admission identity + process witness + exact raw packet digest.

Before cohort commit, controller revalidates that the captured node admission remains current/healthy/eligible. If re-registration/rejoin superseded it, reject the envelope as stale authority even if logical node_id, capability and health now look identical under a new admission.
Atomic cohort_id is derived from ordered authority-envelope digests and the starting S1 identity, not from raw source_node_id alone.

training_eval_reinjection.learned_target_boundary: Model learns the cognitive result body only. Membership admission IDs, process witness IDs, coordinator leases, CAS values and final authority-envelope digests remain deterministic evaluator/runtime fields.
eval_concepts: logical identity is not membership incarnation identity
packet integrity is not source authority
authority masking must survive runtime integration, not only dataset schema
old evidence can remain immutable evidence while its current source authority is revoked
same-cohort proof requires process->raw packet->authority envelope->cohort admission continuity

counterhypothesis.claim: For a trusted benchmark fixture, logical node_id+healthy+capability plus parent-owned PID proof is sufficient and membership reincarnation is outside scope.
counterhypothesis.answer: That can justify a narrower trusted-fixture component label, but not reusable NODE_RESULT source provenance or restart/rejoin semantics. The reusable HCU path should retain explicit incarnation identity.

next_exact_action: Fuse the monotonic membership-admission acceptance into the current atomic cohort path through a deterministic authority envelope around the immutable raw NODE_RESULT packet. Add stale-rejoin and witness-transplant negatives before any new physical GRID10 runtime promotion. Preserve current FreeSwarm HARD_OFF and do not treat blocked execution as scientific failure.
